projects.name: Eitri
projects.summary: A statically typed scripting language for embedding in Rust.
projects.description: Scripts are type-checked and compiled to verified bytecode before they run, then executed by a register-based interpreter with execution budgets. It also runs this site's customisation console, compiled to WebAssembly.

projects.name: VYR
projects.summary: A native code editor for macOS, built around selections.
projects.description: A Rust editing core behind a C interface, a Swift and AppKit app, and Metal text rendering. Every command works on many selections at once, with a modal keymap alongside the standard macOS shortcuts.
highlights: Selection-first editing: multiple selections, structural selection by syntax node, text objects, and regex select, split and keep.
Tree-sitter highlighting, indentation and folding; language servers kept in sync incrementally.
Git built in: gutter change markers with per-hunk stage and revert, inline blame, and a source control navigator.
Undo history as a tree, with time travel, local history snapshots and crash recovery.

projects.name: Web Server
projects.summary: A TCP server written in AArch64 assembly.
projects.description: A small HTTP server written directly against system calls in AArch64 assembly.

projects.name: Bloom Light
projects.summary: An e-commerce storefront and admin, running in production.
projects.description: Storefront, admin dashboard, and the infrastructure to deploy and run them.
highlights: Storefront and admin dashboard with containerised infrastructure, PostgreSQL, and object storage.
Deployments automated with GitHub Actions; private networking, reverse proxy, and TLS.

projects.name: Reqstly
projects.summary: A self-hosted request tracker in Rust and TypeScript.
projects.description: Ships with its own deployment stack, metrics, and centralised logging.

projects.name: PresenceKit
projects.description: Native tooling that shares desktop activity as Discord presence.
